comment: torchaudio 2.11.1's compiled extension is built for torch 2.11 and does not load with the project's torch 2.14.1; without the .so files torchaudio falls back to its pure-Python code (its _load_lib returns False when the file is absent), which is all pyannote needs.
post_install: import importlib.util, pathlib; s = importlib.util.find_spec('torchaudio'); d = pathlib.Path(list(s.submodule_search_locations)[0]) / 'lib'; [p.unlink() for p in d.glob('*.so')]; print('removed the torchaudio extension')
